cohort: 165,975 singleton, cephalic, nonanomalous deliveries to obese women from the 2007-2011 California Linked Patient Discharge Data-Birth Cohort File
finding: Elective labor induction after 39 weeks of gestation was associated with reduced maternal and neonatal morbidity among obese women.
mod_finding: Elective induction of labor after 39 weeks of gestation was associated with reduced odds of cesarean delivery among obese women.
